status.detail: The corrected classic-consumption attempt reached WinUI compilation but failed to produce the required GPOWrapper projection. Saved graph and output evidence identifies a review-runner-induced shared CsWinRT response/stamp/output collision, not a product-source defect. All eleven referenced projects and their package/runtime/output identities were inventoried. A new runner uses the existing MSBuild import hook to isolate generated projections by project, platform, configuration, framework and runtime identifier, without editing product projects, changing dependencies or copying outputs. Static XML and parser checks passed; hook evaluation, actual path expansion and runtime behavior remain unverified. A separately serialized attempt is assigned with the original finite custody limits, source pins and exact single-test TRX requirements. No result from that attempt is claimed. Earlier failed runs and their cleanup evidence remain failures, not successful validation.
